cohort: The study included all women who gave birth in a training and research hospital in eastern Turkey between January 2018 and December 2022.
finding: Over a 5-year period, 51.47% (4265 of 8287) of pregnant women delivered by cesarean section, with Robson groups 1, 2, and 5 being the largest contributors to the overall cesarean section rate.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 99.88% of women who had a previous cesarean section (Robson group 5), and recommendations include increasing vaginal deliveries after cesarean section.
